title: Product selector pair distribution
statement: Let $\Omega$ be finite, let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\theta\in[-1,1]$. Draw $n$ independent coordinate pairs from the selector coordinate pair distribution with base distribution $\pi$ and parameter $\theta$, then regard these pairs as two $n$-tuples in $\Omega$. Their joint distribution is the product selector pair distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
